meta.title: Offering in a different unit is refused
gaps: The exact vendor-side unit control and valid alternative unit option are not defined in the catalog.
The submitted bid's persisted unit cannot be compared with the requested unit through a dedicated assertion.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The exact vendor-side unit control and valid alternative unit option are not defined in the catalog.; The submitted bid's persisted unit cannot be compared with the requested unit through a dedicated assertion.

steps.note: Start a multi-stage project create flow suitable for an RFQ.
Give the event the required title before publishing.
Use an RFQ pricing stage for the vendor offer.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the vendor has an offer row.
Populate the buyer pricing sheet for the line item.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the offer.
Publish the event so the vendor portal can access it.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's pricing offer form in the vendor portal.
Attempt to change the offer unit; this uses the unconfirmed generic Unit label because no domain step exposes the vendor unit control.
